target.title: fix: preserve Codex quota when status uses default runtime
target.body:
Closes #105184

AI-assisted: Yes (Codex)

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Codex app-server users would lose the usage/quota line from `/status` when the session still used the `codex` provider but the displayed runtime fell back to OpenClaw Default. The line could also remain absent when a separate rate-limit read did not inherit the active session's ChatGPT authentication.

## Why This Change Was Made

Treat `provider=codex` as authoritative for synthetic Codex usage and resolve its status/auth lookup through the OpenAI profile path even when the displayed harness is the default runtime. Rate-limit reads now reuse the auth-matched shared app-server client and fall back only to that exact physical client's existing, ten-minute rate-limit cache when the live read fails; this avoids transcript scanning and prevents quota data from crossing agent, profile, or client boundaries.

## User Impact

Codex app-server users can continue to see their remaining quota in chat `/status` and CLI status output after the runtime label falls back to OpenClaw Default. A transient or unauthenticated live quota probe can use a recent snapshot already owned by the active Codex client instead of silently dropping the usage line.

## Evidence

- Focused regression suite on Node 24.15.0: 4 Vitest shards passed across `extensions/codex/src/app-server/request.test.ts`, `extensions/codex/provider.test.ts`, `extensions/codex/src/app-server/rate-limit-cache.test.ts`, `src/status/codex-synthetic-usage.test.ts`, `src/auto-reply/reply/commands-status.test.ts`, and `src/commands/status-runtime-shared.test.ts`. Repeated after rebasing onto the latest `origin/main` (`bd9bedb201`).
- Targeted `oxfmt --check`, core/extension Oxlint, and `git diff --check` passed for all nine changed files.
- Regression coverage proves default-runtime chat and CLI eligibility, reproduction of the prepared-auth shared-client key, fallback to the same physical client's cache, and rejection of another client's cached quota.
- Upstream Codex contract checked at `c888e8e75a9f0e90ce7d5517f8b9540832cbbf76`: `account/rateLimits/read` requires ChatGPT auth, while rolling rate-limit notifications update client-owned state.
- Live account validation was not run because no safe test ChatGPT credential was available; the fork CI remains the independent type-aware/build validation path.
